official_access.repository_family: public GitHub repositories whose names begin with osbooks-
official_access.access_mode: official OpenStax Git repositories containing collections/, modules/, media/, META-INF/ and per-repository LICENSE files
official_access.listing_rule: Enumerate public non-archived repositories in the official openstax organization, select names beginning with osbooks-, pin each repository by exact commit SHA, and inspect its LICENSE before extraction/publication. Do not hardcode a transient repository list in the Atlas source descriptor.

scope.corpus: OpenStax textbook content repositories across mathematics, natural sciences, engineering-adjacent subjects, economics, business, medicine/life sciences and social sciences
structures: explicit MathML <math> elements embedded in CNXML modules
inequalities, functions, distributions, transformations and other source-attested mathematical structures represented in MathML
scope.original_representation: exact lexical MathML subtree from the CNXML module
scope.batching: one OpenStax repository at one exact commit per source_snapshot/materialization batch
exclusions: Do not infer formulas from prose in this lane
Do not OCR media or equation images in this lane
Do not treat generic numeric text as a mathematical occurrence
Repositories without an auditable content license remain index-only until rights are resolved

snapshot_policy.rule: For one official OpenStax osbooks repository, pin an exact Git commit, record the repository LICENSE blob/hash, build a deterministic SHA-256 inventory over the acquired content files, and use openstax:<owner-repo>:git:<commit>:inventory-sha256:<digest> as source_snapshot. A changed commit or changed byte inventory creates a new immutable snapshot/item.

license_policy.rule: Read and hash the repository LICENSE for every snapshot. Carry the observed license on every occurrence. Known Creative Commons licenses may be published only with their attribution, ShareAlike and/or NonCommercial obligations preserved as applicable. If the license is absent, ambiguous, contains content-specific exceptions that are not resolved, or the acquired material is outside the repository license grant, do not publish that payload to the Atlas Internet Archive item; retain only permitted metadata/checksums/provenance.
license_policy.attribution: Preserve OpenStax repository, exact commit, module content-id/title and stable source URL on every occurrence.

adapter.input: one locally acquired and verified OpenStax osbooks repository or CNXML file
validation: The XML parser and lexical scanner must agree on the number of MathML math elements in each accepted CNXML document
expression_original is the exact lexical MathML subtree from source CNXML rather than regenerated XML
source_record_sha256 is based on repository, commit, logical module id, formula index and exact expression hash rather than local checkout path
Module content-id/title, source file, repository, commit, document SHA-256 and nearby text context are preserved
No OCR, prose-to-math reconstruction or algebraic equivalence assertion occurs at extracted stage
